cardEffects:
[Main] You may play 1 [Agumon] or [Gabumon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your level 6 Digimon with [Greymon] or [Garurumon] in its name would leave the battle area outside of a battle, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・That Digimon and a card in the hand may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card with [Omnimon] in its name in the hand.
name: Miraculous Mega Knight

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT17-095 (2025/01/24, translated by DeepL)
Official JP Q&A for BT17-095 (2024/03/22, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: "When [...] would leave the battle area other than by battle" refers to when that Digimon is placed in the trash other than as a result of a battle, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
rulings.question: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area other than by [...] a battle" mean, exactly?

rulings.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve into a Digimon card that doesn’t have [DNA Digivolution].
rulings.question: With this card's ＜Delay＞ effect, can I DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn’t have [DNA Digivolution]?

rulings.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve using Digimon that aren’t specified in [DNA Digivolution].
rulings.question: Does this card's ＜Delay＞ effect allow me to DNA digivolve into a card other than the Digimon specified by [DNA Digivolution] in the hand?

rulings.answer: No, they do not leave the Battle Area. DNA digivolves digivolve as a new Digimon, so it is a different Digimon than the one that leaves.
rulings.question: If two Digimon including the leaving Digimon digivolved by the "Delay" effect of this card, does the Digimon that digivolved DNA digivolves leave the Battle Area?

rulings.answer: When a Digimon leaves the Battle Area other than as a result of a Battle is when it is "placed in trash," "returned to hand or deck," "placed in security," "moved to the Breeding Area," or "placed under another card" other than as a result of a Battle.
rulings.question: What exactly does this card mean "when leaving the Battle Area outside of a battle"?

rulings.answer: No, you cannot ignore the digivolution requirements, so you cannot DNA digivolve to a Digimon card that does not have "digivolves".
rulings.question: Can I use the "Delay" effect of this card to digivolve DNA digivolution to a Digimon card that does not have "Jogress" in my hand?

rulings.answer: No, you cannot ignore the digivolution requirements, so you cannot digivolve DNA digivolves with a Digimon that is not designated as a "digivolution" digivolution.
rulings.question: Can I use the "Delay" effect of this card to perform DNA digivolves with a Digimon not designated as a "digivolve" in my hand?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 card with [Tai Kamiya] or [Matt Ishida] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
